title: ModelDriveFolder
description: Canonical JSON contract for a drive folder resource in jocaagura_domain.

id.description: Unique identifier of the folder resource.

mimeType.description: Canonical MIME type for folders in the Jocaagura logical drive domain.

parentId.description: Identifier of the parent folder. Null represents the root of the logical tree.

path.description: Canonical absolute path of the folder in the logical drive tree.

webUrl.description: Optional web URL that opens the folder.

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 date-time format.

trashed.description: Whether the folder is currently marked as trashed.

meta.description: Optional open metadata bag for provider-specific or indexing details.

childrenCount.description: Optional number of immediate children currently known for the folder.
